description: This bar chart, from the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models," illustrates the Shapley value for three different language models—mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM—across seven distinct linguistic features labeled on the horizontal axis: L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺. The vertical axis, labeled "Shapley value," ranges from 0 to 80 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each linguistic feature is represented by a group of three adjacent bars, each corresponding to one model: mBERT (light gray), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green). The chart shows that for most features, the Shapley values are relatively low, with the exception of the feature labeled "T," where all three models exhibit significantly higher values, with chLSTM reaching approximately 80, XLM-R around 55, and mBERT around 60. The bars are not sorted; they appear in the order of the linguistic features as listed. The legend in the top right corner clearly identifies each model's color. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard representation.
